sections.shortTitle: Sindh Private Medical Education Institutions Regulation and Control Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Sort title and Commencement

SINDH PRIVATE MEDICAL EDUCATION INSTITUTIONS
SINDH PRIVATE
MEDICAL EDUCATION INSTITUTIONS
(REGULATION AND
CONTROL) (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE X OF 2001
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Private Medical Education Institutions (Regulation and Control)
Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, 7th January, 2001]
No. S. Legis. 1(10)/2001,
dated 7-1-2001.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:-
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Private Medical
Education Institutions (Regulation and Control) (Amendment) Ordinance,
2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, 7th January, 2001]
No. S. Legis. 1(10)/2001,
dated 7-1-2001.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:-
2. Amendment of long title of
Sindh Ordinance No. V of 2001.--In the Sindh Private Medical Education
Institutions (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 2001, in the long title for
the words "certain institutions" the words "the institutions
imparting medical education" shawl be substituted and shall be deemed always
to have been so substituted.
